transcript: Are people around you annoyed because you're farting too much? Or are you the one feeling uncomfortable because of constant bloating? My friend, listen closely. Your body is not trying to shame you. It's trying to send you a message. Gas, bloating, tightness in your stomach. These are not random. They're signs your digestion is stressed, inflamed, or simply tired from the way you've been eating and living. When your gut is heavy, your mind becomes heavy. When your digestion struggles, your energy drops, your mood shifts, and even your confidence fades. Most people try to hide the problem, but hiding never heals anything. What actually helps is giving your digestion a moment of peace. Warm meals instead of cold, slowing down when you eat, avoiding heavy late night foods, and supporting your gut with calming herbs like lemon balm tea, which may relax the stomach and reduce bloat. One small change can shift your entire day. And if you want a full step-by-step path to heal your digestion, calm your mind and feel lighter from the inside out. Join my 30-day healing journey. The link is in my profile.
